query:
UPDATE sessions
             SET status = $1,
                 tokens_in = $2,
                 tokens_out = $3,
                 cache_read_tokens = $4,
                 cache_write_tokens = $5,
                 ended_at = to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')
             WHERE id = $6
